thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: PROD cluster 'us-west-2' -> inference-pool nodes reporting kubelet NotReady flapping (5 nodes). Severity: P1. Pager sent to #eng-oncall.

marta_oncall: acked, I'm paged. seeing increased 5xxs on /v1/generate and latency spikes in the console. routing fallback already kicking to eu-west for some customers.

leo_infra: pulling node list now. `kubectl get nodes -l pool=inference-usw -o wide` shows 5 nodes rotate NotReady, kubelet restart count bumped. Suspect node-level kernel/GPU issue.

ryan_runtime: any RK logs? could be driver crash causing container OOMs to cascade.

leo_infra: paste: ```
$ kubectl get nodes -l pool=inference-usw -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}{" "}{.status.conditions[?(@.type=="Ready")].status}{"\n"}{end}'
ip-10-0-4-12 NotReady
ip-10-0-6-55 NotReady
ip-10-0-7-21 NotReady
ip-10-0-8-90 Ready
ip-10-0-9-03 NotReady
```

leo_infra: diags from one node: ```
Mar 15 18:02:11 kernel: NVRM: GPU at 00000000:3B:00.0 has fallen off the bus.
Mar 15 18:02:13 kubelet[1234]: E090 18:02:13 ... kubelet: container runtime runc: failed to start container: error running container: exit status 1
Mar 15 18:03:02 systemd[1]: kubelet.service: Main process exited, code=exited, status=255/EXCEPTION
```

marta_oncall: OK that looks like intermittent GPU driver/kernel flaps. Impact: inference shards on those nodes evacuated -> request queueing -> 5xx/timeout for some customers. Mitigation plan: cordon + drain unhealthy nodes, spin up hot spare nodes in same AZ with older driver, and shift traffic by adjusting routing policy to favor eu-west/dedicated fallback.

sre_pager: +1 to cordon/drain, but need to throttle evictions to avoid mass rescheduling overload. Use `--grace-period=30 --delete-local-data`? keep short to free GPUs fast.

leo_infra: running commands now: ```
kubectl cordon ip-10-0-4-12 && kubectl drain ip-10-0-4-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=30
```

ops-bot: AUTO: created replacement node group (gp-infer-hotspare-usw-2) size +3, startup begun (ASG scale event).

ryan_runtime: temp routing change: raising cost for inference-usw pool in runtime-router by 20% so traffic gradually shifts. Also enabling fallback model q1-small on eu-west for critical customers.

marta_oncall: notifying customer-facing slack + CSEs: "We're seeing transient GPU driver/kernel issues in us-west inference nodes causing elevated 5xxs and latency. Mitigations in progress: draining unhealthy nodes, spinning hot spares, and shifting traffic. No data plane compromise."

leo_infra: node drain outputs for 3 nodes show pods evicted, but one node stuck due to a stuck runc process. Attaching commands: ```
kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=ip-10-0-7-21
container-runtime-refused 0/3 CrashLoopBackOff  3d  inference-service-abc-123  ip-10-0-7-21
```

ryan_runtime: for stuck runc, trying `crictl ps` on node via ssh and `systemctl restart docker` then `systemctl restart kubelet`. If driver crash, may need host reboot.

leo_infra: SSHed, found `nvidia-smi` failing with "NVIDIA-SMI has failed because it couldn't communicate with the NVIDIA driver." Restarting nvidia-persistenced and docker, kubelet. Still flaky. Plan: isolate node and file a hardware/host reboot.

marta_oncall: action items: 1) leo isolate+reboot bad nodes 2) ops-bot ensure hotspare nodes become ready 3) ryan continue routing/fallback 4) marta coordinate customer comms and watch error budget.

ops-bot: HOTSPARE: 3 instances registered to cluster, kubelet ready on 2/3, one is still pulling large model artifacts (quantized weights).

sre_pager: note: keep an eye on autoscaler — don't let it scale down core inference infra while we drain. Lock min-size on core group to current+0.

marta_oncall: status update to #customer-notifications: "Mitigation in flight — traffic rerouted and replacement capacity adding. We expect reduced errors within 10-15m. We'll update with root cause once we have node-level diagnostics." :heavy_check_mark:

leo_infra: reboot sequence done for 2 nodes, both come back NotReady -> kubelet crash loop. Gathering systemd journal: ```
systemd[1]: kubelet.service: Failed with result 'signal' after restart.
journalctl -u kubelet -n 200 | tail -n 40
Aug 10 18:12:01 kubelet[1234]: panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
```

ryan_runtime: runtime stack trace implies libc or driver-level segfault getting surfaced to kubelet. This isn't just runc; likely kernel module mismatch after recent kernel patch? Cross-check image/kernel/drivers versions.

marta_oncall: escalate to EM and infra lead — @leo_infra please add to incident timeline and runbook. We need a postmortem.

leo_infra: added timeline in incident tracker, creating ticket INFRA-4392 for hardware vendor if nodes keep flapping after reboot.

ops-bot: MONITOR: error rate on /v1/generate dropped ~60% after routing change and hotspare registration. Current customer impact reduced but still elevated for ~12% of requests from us-west.

sre_pager: preparing handoff — my shift ends in 50m. Marta, can you take primary for the incident if it goes into prolonged remediation?

marta_oncall: I will. Starting a bridged call with infra and runtime in 5. Posting join link to thread.

ryan_runtime: temp workaround proposal for next 24h: mark nodes with driver version X.Y.Z as ineligible for inference scheduling and provision workers with older validated driver X.Y.W. This prevents mass regression while we debug kernel/driver mismatch.

marta_oncall: approved, ops: please create a tag/pool for validated-driver=vX.Y.W and move critical customer routes there.

ops-bot: TASK: pool tag created and routing rules updated for critical-customer group.

marta_oncall: final note: filing incident with SRG, we'll capture RCA after kernel/driver matrix tested. Handoff to oncall cover @sre_pager for night. I'll keep on rotation oversight.

sre_pager: thanks team. leaving running watch on metrics and will escalate if nodes start flapping again. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied, priority reduced to P2 for monitoring. Incident thread archived when resolved.
